items.claim: Account, workspace, models, environment, secrets, database, Stripe, GitHub, integrations, storage, usage, security, and desktop-local settings are represented with explicit scope and authority.
Synthetic values are accepted transiently for explicit fixture creation or replacement; snapshots, calls, results, audit events, errors, and rendered state contain metadata only.
Supabase health, schema summaries, migration, storage, auth, and RLS states plus safe/destructive change previews are fixture presentation only; SQL apply and rollback are unavailable.
Stripe, GitHub, model providers, Supabase, and a future external service expose health, scope, auth classification, handoff, and mutation availability without live provider calls.
D8 local project type, framework, Git state, and supplied size metadata may be shown; environment files are not read and projects are not uploaded.
Optional stable reads require injected transport and explicit origin-relative routes; no default production origin or mutation method exists.
Production secrets, environments, database changes, OAuth, provider mutations, durable audit, cloud workspace authority, and Builder V2 integration remain unavailable.
